description.narrative: Zambia II Compact - Access to Financial Service Project: The Asset Finance Project aims to increase access to finance for investment in energy, irrigation, logistics, processing (EILP) equipment and infrastructure for agriculture value chains for both men and women-owned agricultural small and medium enterprises (Agri-SMEs) and project developers. The Agri-SME Asset Financing Activity (AAF Activity) aims to improve Agri-SMEs access to affordable financing by providing funding for: 1. Performance based grants to financial service providers (FSPs) and equipment providers (EPs) to incentivize lending and finance to Agri-SMEs 2. Design of an impact-investing funding vehicle that raises funds for Zambian agri-enterprises 3. Technical assistance to build capacity for lending to Agri-SMEs and to Agri-SME borrowers to improve financial literacy, business planning, and linkages to market opportunities. The Zambia Project Preparation Facility for EILP (ZAMPPF Activity) aims to increase the number of EILP infrastructure projects that support agriculture value chains to reach financial close by providing: 1. Technical assistance to project developers (e.g., GRZ and private developers) to develop bankable EILP infrastructure projects; 2. Technical assistance and capacity building for public and private project developers.

condition.narrative: Further details on conditions precedent affecting this activity can be found in the top-level parent activities.
